ordinary: Opt-in; ordinary Pi works without context tools.
empty: Transition without notes; goal/instructions and original user history survive.
rollover: Real outbound context drops original assistant/tool evidence; IDs locate exact raw text and mismatched pairs fail.
repeated: Three windows; updated summary replaces old conclusions and earliest evidence remains retrievable.
resume: Normal process restart; same session/window, current summary, later user correction, stable old item IDs.
notes: Prefix listing, cursor pagination, Unicode reads, replacement, beyond-end reads, 64 KiB boundary, failed writes preserve prior content.
history: Ordered literal search, conjunctive role/tool/window filters, pagination, bounded previews, Unicode reconstruction, user and assistant-tool-call archive.
batch: All tools after new_context in the same assistant response complete once and are archived before transition.
isolation: Second session in same workspace cannot see notes, search results, or old item/window IDs.
invalid: Invalid paths, limits, cursors, missing notes/items, unknown new_context fields, and summary overflow.
